remarks: Owner extremely motivated and ready to deal-make him an offer- Seller has already purchased a new home and moved-so this is your opportunity to acquire this townhouse at a nice price! Lovely and handy 2 bedroom townhouse in Castile Heights subdivision! This is a coveted End Unit which gives you the side yard as well for privacy and more room ! The recently vinyl sided exterior compliments the landscaping and the good sized lot with nice trees for shade! As you walk into the entryway, you will see beyond to the vaulted living room with dining area. This brings openness and airiness and a feeling of space! To the left is the 3-season carpeted sunroom with 3 sets of sliding doors that let sunshine and air in ( a room you will absolutely live in during the spring, summer and fall months). To the right is the space-saver kitchen, compact yet cozy! A hallway leads to the laundry closet and 2 bedrooms, each with closets. For those wanting a small home in a cul-de-sac at the edge of the village, this town house may check the boxes! Replacements and upgrades: Brand new carpet and paint, vinyl siding on exterior-2026, Roof replaced in 2008, 3  sliding doors in sunroom have been replaced, new 'Bathfitter' brand tub and surround 6 months ago, windows replaced approx. 20 years ago. This all electric town house has a balanced billing of approx. $175/month; no gas bill, just electric! The 12' foot storage shed fits mower, garden supplies, lawn furniture, tools and outdoor equipment. Just a short distance to Russell Joy Park, downtown restaurants/stores and village commons park, fountain, opera House and Farmer's Market. Very cozy and enjoyable town house!!
